Sirf ek cheez se darna hai, wo khud dar.
Himmat mein genius aur shakti hai.
Grit kacchi dridh-ta hai.
Silence dimaag ki neend hai.
Strong actions hi sabse loud bolte hain.
Veer wahi jo sirf darr hi nahi, shak ko bhi paar karta hai.
Restraint mein power—silence.
Jo tum ho aur jo tum chahte ho—difference action hai.
Grit talent nahi; strategy hai.
Grit charitra banata hai.
Himmat badi hai.
Sabse badi shaan kabhi na girna nahi, balki har girne ke baad uthna hai.
Sher kutton ke liye nahi mudta.
Sabse mushkil hai act karne ka faisla; baaki sab bas tenacity hai.
Grit pain ko purpose banata.
Himmat chingari hai.
Grit grind ko respect karti hai.
Grit setbacks ko setups banata.
Jahan simplicity, goodness aur truth nahi, wahan greatness nahi hoti.
Khamoshi bolne se zyada eloquent hoti.
Khamoshi weakness nahi—strength hai.
